pieces.name: Mustard hooded raincoat
queries: yellow waterproof rain jacket snap hood
pieces.styleNotes: Warm mustard/yellow raincoat with a hood, mid-thigh length and snap or zip front. Keep it open to show the navy stripes. Exact mustard is available in limited Tanta sizes; other tiers use brighter yellow.

matches.reason: Mustard yellow waterproof A-line rain jacket with drawstring hood, elasticated cuffs and a large back pleat. Closest color match, but shorter and more flared than the reference.
